questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 1: Units and Measurements

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Water shows anomalous expansion: on being cooled from 4 °C to 0 °C it:
questions.explanation: Water is densest at 4 °C, so in a frozen lake the water at the bottom stays at 4 °C while ice floats on top, which is what allows aquatic life to survive the winter.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 10: Thermal Properties of Matter

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The chief drawback of Rutherford's nuclear model of the atom was that it could not explain:
options: The stability of the atom and the observed line spectrum
questions.explanation: A revolving electron is accelerated, so classical theory says it must radiate energy continuously, spiral inwards and give a continuous spectrum. Bohr's quantised orbits fixed both problems.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: A 2p orbital has a nodal plane passing through the nucleus. The number of such nodal planes in a single p orbital is:
questions.explanation: The number of angular or planar nodes equals l, which is 1 for a p orbital. This is why a p orbital is dumb-bell shaped with zero electron density at the nucleus.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 2: Structure of Atom

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Transition metals and their compounds make good catalysts mainly because they:
options: Show variable oxidation states and provide a large surface for adsorption
questions.explanation: The ability to change oxidation state lets the metal accept and give back electrons during the reaction, as iron does in the Haber process and vanadium pentoxide in the contact process.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 12, Chapter 4: The d- and f-Block Elements

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Which of the following pairs of vitamin and deficiency disease is correctly matched?
questions.explanation: Vitamin D deficiency causes rickets in children and osteomalacia in adults. B₁ deficiency gives beriberi, vitamin C scurvy and vitamin A night blindness.

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: In a plant breeding programme using artificial hybridisation, emasculation means:
options: Covering the flower with a bag
Removing the anthers from the flower bud of the female parent before they dehisce
Collecting pollen from the male parent
questions.explanation: Emasculation stops self pollination, and the flower is then bagged to keep unwanted pollen out until the desired pollen is dusted on the stigma.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 1: Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: The respiratory pathway is described as amphibolic rather than purely catabolic because:
options: Its intermediates are withdrawn for the synthesis of fats, proteins and other compounds as well
It occurs only in the dark
questions.explanation: Acetyl CoA is drawn off for fatty acid synthesis and keto acids of the Krebs cycle for amino acids, so the pathway serves both breakdown and build-up.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 12: Respiration in Plants

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: The most reliable technique for confirming whether a suspected tumour is cancerous is:
options: Biopsy and histopathological study of the tissue
questions.explanation: A piece of tissue is sectioned, stained and examined for cancerous cells. Radiography, CT and MRI help locate internal tumours, and antibody based tests detect some cancers.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 7: Human Health and Disease

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: The colostrum produced by the mother in the first few days after childbirth is especially valuable to the newborn because it is rich in:
options: Antibodies, especially IgA, which build the infant's resistance
questions.explanation: Colostrum is yellowish and thick, and the IgA it carries coats the infant's gut lining, which is why exclusive breastfeeding in the early months is strongly advised.
